label: post-test-process-check
command:
cd /home/alica-dev/AlicaV2 && export PATH="$PWD/.tools/node/bin:$PATH"; python3 -c 'import pathlib,os,json
matches=[]
for p in pathlib.Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  argv=(p/"cmdline").read_bytes().split(bytes([0]))
  if any(x.endswith((b"/tools/g7-supervisor.py",b"/tools/g7-cell-owner.mjs")) for x in argv):
   matches.append({"pid":int(p.name),"argv":[x.decode(errors="replace") for x in argv if x]})
 except (OSError,ValueError):pass
print(json.dumps({"remainingG7CustodianOrOwnerProcesses":matches},indent=2))
assert not matches
'
